# Was the KEPCO customer data breach a hack?

**Reported.** KEPCO says an outside attacker broke into its KEPCO ON and SRM systems and stole data on about 1.52 million people. We read this only via outlets, so it stays Reported. Method and attacker are not established.

Incident: KEPCO customer data breach, Nov 2026. Also reported as the KEPCO ON leak and KEPCO's second breach. First published Nov 22, 2026; last updated Nov 22, 2026, 6:17 AM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by KEPCO, Yonhap, Chosunbiz, Financial News, Electronic Times, Aju Press, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 22, 2026, 6:17 AM ET: **KEPCO says an outside attacker took data on about 1.52 million users; claims are Reported, cause not established.** First draft. 7 sources (all Tier 2), 11 claims, 5 questions. KEPCO says an outside attacker took data on about 1.52 million users from KEPCO ON and the SRM procurement system. All of it is Reported, since we read only outlets relaying the company's statement. The method, attacker and any link to the October breach are Not established. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. KEPCO, South Korea's state-run power utility, says 1,520,248 user records were leaked across two systems; the count of distinct people is not given.
- Who is affected: Users of KEPCO ON (electricity bills and payment) and of the SRM procurement system, including company representatives and staff. KEPCO has a desk to check whether you were affected.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1.52M | Records leaked, per KEPCO | 1,520,248 across two systems |
| 650,487 | KEPCO ON users | About 7.1% of its users |
| 869,761 | SRM procurement users | Representatives and staff |
| 35,528 | October breach, people | A separate earlier leak |

### Known so far

- Nothing is established yet.

### Not known yet

- How the attacker got in.
- Who the attacker was.
- Whether this is linked to the October breach.
- How many distinct people are affected, without double counting.
- Whether the leaked data has been misused.

## What we checked and did not find

We looked for these and did not find them as of the time of this report on Nov 22, 2026.

- KEPCO's own notice or apology page. We read only outlets relaying it, which is why the main claim is Reported, not Confirmed.
- A cause report or any detail of how the attacker got in.
- Any claim of responsibility, or any attacker named.
- A de-duplicated count of distinct people affected.
- A statement from police or the privacy regulator on this incident.
- Any report of the leaked data being misused or offered for sale.
- Any finding on whether this and the October breach are connected.
